title: Early Career Net Worth Trajectory Engine
description: Projects 10-year net worth for early-career individuals across three savings scenarios (aggressive/base/conservative ±10pp). Inputs: starting salary, growth rate, savings rate, student debt, 401k match, filing status. Uses 2026 IRS projected tax brackets. Outputs: year-by-year net worth, portfolio, debt, break-even year, milestone calendar. Policy Mandate v2.0 mandate: net_worth_trajectory_record.
data_vintage: IRS 2026 tax brackets (projected); SS/Medicare 7.65%; IRS 401k limit $23,500; Damodaran 2024 equity returns
regulatory_citations: IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-22 — 2026 tax bracket inflation adjustments (projected)
IRS Notice 2025-82 — 2026 retirement plan contribution limits ($23,500)
Damodaran Online 2024 — historical US equity risk premium and real returns (~7%)

mcp_tool_definition.name: project_early_career_net_worth
mcp_tool_definition.description: Given starting salary, growth, savings rate, student debt, 401k match, and filing status, returns 10-year net worth projections for aggressive/base/conservative scenarios. Uses 2026 projected tax brackets. Deterministic.
